hero.h1: Catch Basin Cleaning and Repair in Highland Park, IL
hero.sub: A catch basin collects rain and yard water and sends it where it should go. When it fills with leaves and silt, water pools in the yard, driveway or against the house. We clean and repair catch basins for homeowners across Highland Park and the North Shore.

img.alt: Cast iron catch basin grate at the edge of an asphalt driveway, partly covered with fallen leaves next to a landscaped garden bed

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.h2: What Does a Catch Basin Do?
blocks.body: A catch basin is an underground box with a grate on top, usually at a low point in the yard, driveway or near the house. Surface water drains in, heavy debris settles to the bottom, and the water flows out through a pipe. Outdoor catch basins fill up with debris over time and block surface drainage. We clean them out and restore flow, and repair basins that have cracked, shifted or collapsed.

img.alt: Diagram of a catch basin showing the inlet grate, water line, sediment settling in the sump and the outlet pipe carrying water away

blocks.h2: Signs Your Catch Basin Needs Service
blocks.intro: A catch basin problem usually shows up as water where it shouldn't be:

tiles.body: Puddles that sit around the grate for hours after a storm mean the basin or its outlet pipe is blocked.
Leaves, mulch and silt piled at or under the grate are a sign the basin is full and water is backing up.

tiles.h3: Sinking Ground or a Loose Grate
tiles.body: A grate that shifts, or ground that sinks around the basin, points to a cracked or collapsing structure.
If yard water is pooling against the house, a blocked basin can push it toward the foundation and into the basement.

blocks.h2: Catch Basins on Highland Park Properties
blocks.intro: Highland Park's wooded lots and ravines are beautiful, and they send a lot of leaves and debris toward every drain on the property.

items.body: Fall leaves, seed pods and mulch wash into catch basins with every storm. On heavily treed lots, basins fill faster and need cleaning more often.

Heavy rain and spring snowmelt already push water toward Highland Park basements. A clear catch basin moves surface water away from the house instead of toward it. For water that's already getting in, see [basement flooding](/highland-park/basement-flooding).

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: We find out why the water isn't draining before we recommend anything.

steps.body: We check the basin, the grate and the outlet pipe. A camera can show us if the pipe leaving the basin is blocked or broken.
Most basins just need a cleaning. If the structure is cracked or collapsing, we'll show you and explain the repair.
You get a flat-rate price before any work begins.

blocks.h2: Catch Basin Questions From Highland Park Homeowners

items.q: How often should a catch basin be cleaned?
items.preview: It depends on debris. Basins under mature trees may need it every year.
items.answer: It depends on how much debris reaches it. Basins under mature trees can need cleaning every year, while others go longer. If water is standing around the grate after rain, it's time.

items.q: Can a clogged catch basin cause basement flooding?
items.preview: Yes. A blocked basin can send yard water toward the foundation.
items.answer: It can. A blocked basin lets surface water pool in the yard or against the foundation, and that water can find its way into the basement. Keeping the basin clear is one of the simplest ways to move water away from the house.

items.q: How much does catch basin repair cost?
items.preview: It depends on cleaning versus repair. You get a flat price before any work begins.
items.answer: It depends on whether the basin needs a cleaning, an outlet pipe cleared or structural repair, and how easy it is to reach. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
